hints.title: Pivoting Stores into Columns
hints.text: Group records by product identifier and conditionally aggregate the price for each distinct store.

hints.title: Conditional Aggregation per Store
hints.text: Use case when expressions checking store = "store1", "store2", and "store3" respectively.

hints.title: Selecting Extracted Values
hints.text: Wrap the case statements with sum or max aggregate functions to pivot values into columns.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN store = 'store1' THEN price END) AS store1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN store = 'store2' THEN price END) AS store2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN store = 'store3' THEN price END) AS store3
FROM Products
GROUP BY product_id;
```

complexity.time: O(N) single pass grouping by product_id
complexity.space: O(U) hash table for distinct product identifiers
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate self-joins for each store add join overhead and require complex full outer join handling.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single group-by scan computes all column values simultaneously.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should pivot rows into columns using SUM/MAX with CASE WHEN.
